snippet.title: Tiberium Dusk 1.26 Chronolator Hexapod Singularity Cannon demo
snippet.description:
Demo of the new Singularity Cannon weapon used by the Traveler 59 Chronolator Hexapod. Firing a dark matter ray and singularity core, this weapon can wreck entire platoons in a single shot.
Mod: https://www.moddb.com/mods/tiberium-dusk
Discord server: https://discord.gg/8Cpfepqczy
